title: Path of souls: the soul's leap to Orion and journey along the Milky Way
place_text: North, Central and South America; worldwide

tellings.quote: Absolutely. It is it is here it in in North America. Uh and and in Central America and in South America. The the path of souls.

plain: There is an old belief, the path of souls, in which the soul of the dead leaps to the constellation Orion and then travels along the Milky Way, and it is found across North, Central and South America. The writer on lost ancient civilisations Graham Hancock says this to Michels without naming a source, and he points to his series Ancient Apocalypse. For him it is a sign that peoples far apart once shared the same picture of the sky and of death.
